title: Preflight 1:1 - Nora Patel -> Rafael Gomez - Aug 30 2027
content:
Meeting purpose: quick calibrate, unblock Rafael, and surface coaching signals. Keep to 30 minutes. This is a lightweight preflight — bring a single concrete ask and the current signal for it.

Key context (one-liners):
- Rafael is leading the quantized-model latency investigation (INF-901).
- Infra rollout for autoscaling knobs is in canary; Rafael owns validation for the new backpressure metric (Linear ISSUE-1423).
- Rafael and team shipped PR #787 for the KV cache soft-eviction, but we saw a perf jitter in staging this week.

Pre-read (send 24h before):
- Short summary of what you tested (3 bullets) + 1 metric snapshot (p50/p95 latency, error rate).
- Link to the failing run and the PR: PR #787 + perf run logs.
- Your single ask for this 1:1 (coaching / decision / stakeholder unblock).

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick personal check-in (2–3m) — energy, anything immediate on your radar.
2) Signals & data (6–8m) — What changed in staging perf? show metric screenshot.
3) Hypotheses and next experiments (8–10m) — decide next test to run and who will own.
4) Career/growth pulse (6m) — short coaching question + 1 concrete suggestion.
5) Action items and follow-ups (2–3m).

Questions I want Rafael to answer (prep prompts):
- What is the minimal repro that reliably shows the jitter? (env, model, seq len, QAT/Quantization type)
- Did the jitter correlate with autoscaling/backpressure events? Provide timestamp ranges.
- Which rollback gives us stable perf (PR revert vs config tweak)?
- If we need more infra time, who do you need me to escalate to (SRE lead / infra PM)?

Signals I'll bring to the meeting:
- P50/P95/token latency for the quantized model over the last 48h (staging and canary).
- Number of backpressure triggers in the 6-hour window around the perf spike.
- Error counts by type (timeouts / OOM / transient errors).

Primary coaching thread (career):
- Rafael is aiming for a senior IC step this cycle. In this 1:1 I want to push observable leadership: make an ops playbook for rollbacks and postmortem template for perf regressions.
- Coaching prompts for Rafael: how to delegate test ownership, and how to run a 1-hour troubleshooting war room without escalating prematurely.

Notes-to-self (manager):
- Push Rafael to pick one owner for the validation checklist — reduce "we'll look into it" ambiguity.
- If Rafael is blocked on infra access, I should ask infra-eng to allocate 1h debugging window next Tue.
- Remember to encourage public comms: a short note in the #serving-runtime channel summarizing the perf story and next steps.

Potential decisions during 1:1:
- If the jitter is tied to PR #787, we either (A) revert and schedule a controlled reattempt, or (B) land a hotfix that disables soft-eviction under heavy tail-latency.
- If autoscaler misfires are observed, enable a conservative backpressure threshold in canary for 24h.

Concrete action items (format: action — owner — due):
- Capture minimal repro and attach a small script + steps to the Linear ticket — Rafael Gomez — by 2027-09-01
- Run a 4-hour controlled staging replay at low load with detailed flamegraphs and attach to PR — Rafael + Eng Ops — by 2027-09-02
- If replay shows autoscaler correlation, open a follow-up RFC for conservative thresholding and add me as reviewer — Rafael — by 2027-09-05
- Draft a one-page rollback/playbook doc for perf regressions (include checklist, monitoring queries, who to ping) — Nora Patel (me) — by 2027-09-03
- Post a concise status update to #serving-runtime after our next staging run — Rafael — same day as run

Follow-up cadence:
- Quick async update in Linear every 48h until resolved.
- 15m sync next Tue morning if we need a live war-room.

Open questions I want to raise if time permits:
- Is test harness flaky? (flaky harness can mask or create jitter)
- Do we need an infra policy to reserve debugging capacity for canary tests?

Meeting artifacts to attach after the 1:1:
- Screenshot of metric dashboard windows used in the convo.
- Link to the replay job and the flamegraphs.
- A short bulleted "decision log" (1 paragraph) capturing our outcome (revert vs hotfix vs more tests).

Tone notes for the 1:1: be direct but supportive. Focus on ownership and reducing cognitive load for Rafael. Avoid diving too deep into implementation — keep to orchestration and decisioning unless Rafael asks for pair-debugging.

Sticky reminders (personal):
- Bring coffee.
- Acknowledge Rafael's recent on-call handling from last week (call out a specific thing he handled well).
- If Rafael asks for help with stakeholder messaging, offer to draft the first blurb.

End of preflight checklist.

Quick log (post-1:1 template I will paste here after the meeting):
- Date/time, attendees, chosen decision, immediate next steps, owners/due-dates, short notes on morale/energy.
